text.en:
Aigis, registered at the Atrium Notarial Hall as a Category III Resident in March 1102. Admitted to St. Marceau Comprehensive School in accordance with Article 36 of the Appendix to the Laterano Civil Rights Charter and Chapter 2, Article 5 of the Regulations on the Administration of Immigrants.
Teacher's Comments: Student Aigis is intelligent, studious, rigorous, and highly responsible, with strict self-discipline. She has achieved commendable results in gun-martial arts series courses. It is hoped she will open up her heart more, try participating in group activities, and enjoy a wonderful campus life alongside her academic progress.
text.zh:
埃癸斯，1102年3月于中庭公证所登记为第三类驻留人员，根据拉特兰公民权利章程附录第三十六条、入境人员管理条例第二章第五条，由圣马尔索综合学校接收入学。
教师评语：埃癸斯同学聪明好学，认真严谨，富有责任心，自我要求严格，在类铳型武装系列课程中取得了不俗的成绩。望能敞开心扉，更多地尝试集体活动，在学习进步之余，亦能享受美好的校园生活。

text.en:
Following her enrollment, student Aigis garnered considerable attention from classmates due to her performance in gun-martial arts courses. Aigis is not a Sankta, yet she wields and skillfully operates multiple weapons resembling firearms. At the conclusion of a certain gun-martial arts class, the adjacent class's Sesa asked whether she was using the rumored replica firearms developed in Columbia, and whether her special way of holding them was related to that. Aigis answered these questions with utmost seriousness; it was not difficult to see that neither the speaker nor the listener understood what the other was talking about.
Dr. {@nickname}, passing by, silently listened for five minutes to the two students' cross-purposed discussion before taking over the topic. They segued from Columbian security company replica firearms to experimental weapons that briefly appeared in Sargon, then discussed the similarities and differences between Iberia-style hand cannons and Laterano-style launchers, and even mentioned research once attempted by Closure of the engineering club. Sesa listened with rapt attention, entirely forgetting the question he had originally posed to Aigis. Aigis similarly listened intently to Dr.{@nickname}'s impromptu lecture on gun-martial equipment development, a gleam flashing in her eyes from time to time.
After the lecture concluded, Aigis followed Dr.{@nickname} all the way to the office door. The teacher turned around and asked, "Student Aigis, do you have any other questions?" Aigis replied, "I have memorized everything you just said. Also—were you helping me out just now? Thank you." Pausing slightly, Aigis continued, "I would also like to ask, are the weapons you mentioned similar to my configuration? Which aspects are similar specifically..."
It seemed the teacher did not expect Aigis to say this. Pausing for a second, the teacher answered, "Not really. You and those are different." Then, the teacher seemed to blink (due to the hood and mask, it was impossible to be certain) and said, "However, if you need equipment maintenance, you can discuss it with Closure; she should be able to help."

One of the sticky notes attached to this page: Per Dr.{@nickname}'s request, Closure's "technical exchange correspondence" is appended to this file.
Second sticky note attached to this page: Amiya, there's no need to black out Closure's complaints about me in the letter; being misunderstood as some technical secret would achieve the exact opposite effect. Student Aigis uses non-Laterano replica firearms; recording it as such is sufficient.
text.zh:
埃癸斯同学入学后，因为在类铳型武装课程中的表现，获得了不少同学的关注。埃癸斯同学并非萨科塔，但她持有并熟练运用多种与铳械相似的武器。在某次类铳型武装课程授课结束后，隔壁班的慑砂同学询问，她使用的是否是传闻中哥伦比亚开发的仿制铳械，她特殊的持铳方式是否与此有关。埃癸斯同学十分认真地回答了这些问题，不难看出，回答的人和提问的人都没有听懂对方在说什么。
路过的Dr.{@nickname}沉默地聆听了五分钟两位同学文不对题答非所问的讨论之后，接过了话题，从哥伦比亚安保公司的仿制铳械谈到曾在萨尔贡短暂出现的试验武器，再聊到伊比利亚式手炮和拉特兰式发射器的异同，还提到机械社的可露希尔老师曾经尝试过的研究。慑砂同学听得全神贯注，已然忘记了自己最初向埃癸斯同学提出的问题。埃癸斯同学同样认真地听完了Dr.{@nickname}的类铳型装备开发即兴讲学，眼中不时闪过光芒。
讲学结束后，埃癸斯同学跟随Dr.{@nickname}一直走到了办公室门口，老师转过身问：“埃癸斯同学，你还有什么疑问吗？”埃癸斯同学回答道：“我已经记住了您刚才讲的全部内容。还有——您刚刚是在为我解围吧？谢谢您。”稍作踌躇，埃癸斯同学继续说道：“还想再请问一下，您提到的那些武器，和我的配置很相似吗？具体是哪方面相似呢……”
老师似乎没想到埃癸斯会这么说，停顿了一秒，回答道：“并没有。你和它们是不一样的。”然后，老师似乎眨了眨眼（因为有兜帽和面罩，无法确定），说：“不过，如果你需要维护装备，可以去和可露希尔老师商量，她应该能帮得上忙。”

贴在本页的便签之一：根据Dr.{@nickname}的要求，将可露希尔老师的“技术交流信件”附在此档案中。
贴在本页的便签之二：阿米娅，可露希尔信里抱怨我的话不用涂黑的，被误会成什么技术机密就适得其反了。埃癸斯同学使用的是非拉特兰式的仿制铳械，这样记录就可以了。

text.en:
After participating in the confectionery hall's volunteer practice, the transfer students would occasionally spend their leisure time there. Aigis seemed quite fond of sweets, but not out of a preference for the taste. She put it this way: "Through this period of observation, I have come to understand the reason why Laterano people are so passionate about sweets."
"I've noticed this too; it seems to be because Laterano abounds in sugar crops..." This was Amada's view.
"Eh, isn't it because Laterano people have a sweet tooth that they grow those crops in the first place?" This was Yukari's perspective.
"So it's still a culinary tradition after all..." This was Yamagishi's guess.
"No, the key lies in energy supply efficiency," Aigis stated with absolute confidence. "Sugars are the primary and most direct energy source for the brain. Consuming sugar supplies energy to the brain at the fastest possible speed. That is why Laterano people favor sweets so much; they possess an absolute advantage as energy-supply substances."
"..." This was Makoto's comment.
As Aigis affirmed her own thought: "As expected of Laterano, orderly and exceptionally efficient."
Yukari's expression was somewhat helpless. "Efficient, sure, it's efficient... As for 'order,' don't Laterano people have a different understanding of it than we do? Although Laterano has a lot of 'rules,' things like the 'Public Building Demolition Ordinance'... Rules like that are definitely something our world would never have..."
Unaware of Yukari's critique, Aigis seemed to begin pondering another question: "However, there is one thing I do not understand. Earlier, when Ms. Keira and Ms. Idita were arguing, they said that sweets are the memories of Laterano people. If sufficient energy powder is added to sugar-free ice cream, it would become a more efficient food, and everyone consuming it would form corresponding memories. In that way, wouldn't sugar-free ice cream with energy powder be able to replace sweets?"
Amada furrowed his brow, pondering Aigis's words, while Yamagishi said somewhat uncertainly, "Um... memory and memories aren't entirely the same thing, actually..."
Aigis remained somewhat puzzled, but Makoto nodded at this moment.
"'Memory' and 'memories' are different, I see... No, I need to think about this further." In the end, this is what Aigis said.
text.zh:
参加过甜食礼堂的志愿实践之后，转学生们时不时就会去那里度过闲暇的时光。埃癸斯同学似乎对甜食颇有好感，但并非出于口味。她是这样说的：“经过这段时间的观察，我已经知晓了拉特兰人热衷于甜食的原因。”
“我也留意过这件事呢，似乎是因为拉特兰盛产糖料作物……”这是天田同学的看法。
“咦，难道不是因为拉特兰人嗜甜，他们才会种那些作物吗？”这是岳羽同学的见解。
“所以还是口味上的传统吧……”这是山岸同学的猜测。
“不，关键在于供能效率。”埃癸斯同学胸有成竹地说，“糖类是大脑最主要和最直接的能量来源，摄取糖分能够以最快的速度为大脑供能。所以拉特兰人才会如此青睐甜食，它们作为供能物质有着绝对的优势。”
“……”这是结城同学的发言。
埃癸斯同学肯定了自己的想法：“不愧是拉特兰，秩序井然，效率非凡。”
岳羽同学的表情有点无奈：“效率好像是很有效率啦……至于‘秩序’，拉特兰人的理解和我们是不是不太一样啊。虽然拉特兰是有很多‘规则’，但像是‘公共建筑爆破条例’什么的……这种规则，至少我们的世界是绝不会有的……”
埃癸斯同学没有留意到岳羽同学的评价，她似乎开始思考别的问题了：“但是，有一件事我不明白。之前凯拉小姐和伊蒂达小姐争论时说，甜食是拉特兰人的回忆。如果在无糖冰淇淋里加入足量的能量粉，无糖冰淇淋就会成为更高效的食物，大家食用加入能量粉的无糖冰淇淋，也会形成相应的记忆。这样，加入能量粉的无糖冰淇淋不就可以取代甜食了吗？”
天田同学皱着眉头思索埃癸斯同学的话，山岸同学有些不确定地说：“嗯……记忆和回忆，其实不完全一样吧……”
埃癸斯同学还有些疑惑，但结城同学在此时点了点头。
“‘记忆’和‘回忆’是不同的，原来如此……不，我还要，再思考一下这件事。”最后，埃癸斯同学是这样说的。

text.en:
Information regarding the Requiem Mortuary incident remains undisclosed, but this did not prevent the transfer students from forming good relationships with the two mortuary deacons they met during volunteer practice. On a certain day off, the transfer students and Giada went to help Julio—who previously lived in the Repatriation Apartment—move to his new home. Aigis was very enthusiastic about this, stating, "Leave the luggage transport to me; it will be foolproof.
The problem lay with Julio. Upon arriving at his new residence, he unpacked the luggage he brought back from Columbia, successively pulling out a set of marbles, three sketchbooks, two cushions, and a broken ribbon flute, wearing an expression of utter astonishment. He seemed to have no recollection of more than half the items inside his luggage, leaving Aigis to wait as Julio verified them one by one.
Aigis was quite baffled by this: clearly these items were not essential to Julio's life, so why carry them all the way back to their home country? She added that, provided sufficient energy, she herself could survive in most environments on her own without any external possessions.
Julio apologetically explained: he was in low spirits when leaving Columbia and only hastily packed some items at an Executor's reminder, so he hadn't paid attention to what got put into his luggage.
"However," Julio said, "I still have to thank him. If I had just left these things behind... I would probably regret it now." Looking at those boards, sketchbooks, cushions, and flutes, he wore a nostalgic smile.
Before Aigis could continue questioning, a knock on the door interrupted them. The visitor was a light-blond Executor. Julio warmly greeted him, introducing him as the aforementioned Executor and mentioning that he had invited him to join the housewarming dinner. Recalling Julio's earlier explanation, Aigis directed a question at the Executor:
"Mr. Executor, did you remind Mr. Julio to pack these items because they were necessary for the return journey?"
"No."
"Do you understand their purpose?"
"No."
"...Then why did you have Mr. Julio carry these items? Isn't traveling light more efficient?"
"I agree. I alone am sufficient to ensure the safe return of this citizen to Laterano. But upon returning to Laterano, the citizen must still continue his life, and he might need items whose purpose I do not understand. Therefore, from the standpoint of an Executor, I fulfilled my duty of reminding him."
Though Aigis's doubts were not entirely resolved, she seemed to greatly appreciate the other party's working style, conversing happily with this Executor known for his poor communication skills.
From the look of it, although the volunteer practice failed to provide Aigis with career guidance references, it at least helped her make a friend.
text.zh:
安魂殡仪堂事件的信息仍未披露，但这不妨碍转学生们与志愿实践中结识的两名殡仪堂执事结下良好的关系。某个休息日，转学生们和吉阿达一同去帮此前居住在归国公寓的裘里奥搬家。埃癸斯同学对此很积极，称“搬运行李就交给我吧，必定万无一失”。
问题出在裘里奥身上。到了新的住处，他将从哥伦比亚带回的行李拆封，陆续拿出一副弹珠棋、三个素描本、两个坐垫、一支折断的彩带吹笛，神情是十二分的惊讶。他似乎对自己行李内的一多半物品都没有印象，埃癸斯同学只好等待裘里奥一件件确认。
埃癸斯同学对此很不解：显然这些物品于裘里奥的生活并非必要，为什么要长途携带回国呢？她补充道，只要能源充足，她本人可以只凭自身在绝大部分环境下生存，不需要任何身外之物。
裘里奥抱歉地解释：他离开哥伦比亚时精神不振，是在执行者的提醒下才匆匆收拾了一些物品，所以没有注意到往行李里放了什么。
“不过，”裘里奥说，“还是得感谢他。如果就这么丢下了这些东西……我现在应该会后悔的。”看着那些棋盘、素描本、坐垫和吹笛，他露出了怀念的微笑。
埃癸斯想要继续询问，却被敲门声打断。来人是一位淡金发的执行者，裘里奥热络地和他打招呼，介绍这就是刚才提到的那位执行者，自己也邀请了他来参加搬家聚餐。埃癸斯想到裘里奥之前的解释，便向执行者发问：
“执行者先生，你提醒裘里奥先生打包这些物品，是因为回国旅程需要吗？”
“不需要。”
“你了解它们的作用吗？”
“不了解。”
“……那么，你为什么要让裘里奥先生携带这些物品？轻装行动不是效率更高吗？”
“我同意。我本人足以保障该公民安全回归拉特兰。但在回到拉特兰后，公民仍然要继续自己的生活，他或许会需要一些我不理解其用途的物品。因此我以执行者的立场，尽到提醒的义务。”
虽然埃癸斯同学的疑惑并未完全解决，但她似乎很欣赏对方的行事风格，与这位以不擅沟通著称的执行者相谈甚欢。
这样看来，志愿实践虽然未能为埃癸斯同学提供择业方面的参考，至少帮她交到了朋友。

text.en:
At Dr.{@nickname}'s suggestion, the transfer students visited the Sanctorium together before leaving Laterano.
According to the rules of the Sanctorium, people can pray to the relics—or rather, "make a wish"—through spray-paint graffiti. Upon arriving, the transfer students felt somewhat apprehensive, though the atmosphere here was far more relaxed than expected. Amada felt a bit uneasy about the idea of graffitiing on the relics, but Yukari straightfowardly comforted him: "Just follow local customs. Look, the graffiti on top is already piled many layers deep; we should just do it the Laterano way." While spray painting, Yamagishi observed the relics closely for a moment, and afterward, asked Dr.{@nickname} in a low voice, "Doctor, this... is indeed a machine, right?" The teacher paused to think, then told her, "It doesn't matter anymore."
Makoto did not spray paint a wish on the relics; he smiled at Dr.{@nickname} and said something softly. The teacher nodded in response.
The teacher handed the spray paint can to Aigis, who was standing at the very back, and asked, "Do you have a wish you want to make, Aigis?"
Student Aigis took the spray paint can, but seemed a bit hesitant. She looked toward the relics, gazing at the colorful hues on their surface. From this vantage point, it would be difficult for an ordinary person to fully make out the text and patterns, though perhaps Aigis could.
She finally stepped forward. Unlike the Laterano people who left striking and vibrant graffiti, she seemed only to write a small line of prayer.
Returning to her companions, she handed the spray paint can back to Dr.{@nickname}. Although the teacher had asked about Aigis's wish earlier, the teacher did not press further. Everyone has moments like this, where certain wishes are meant only for oneself.
Student Aigis seemed to want to ask something, but ultimately didn't speak up. She looked back at the relics as sunlight pierced through the dome and fell upon her. Perhaps she already knew that the relics would not answer.
text.zh:
在Dr.{@nickname}的提议下，转学生们在离开拉特兰之前，一同去了一次圣髑安所。
依照圣髑安所的规则，人们可以用喷漆涂鸦的方式对圣髑祈祷，或者说，“许愿”。来到这里，转学生们多少有些局促，好在这里的气氛远比想象中轻松。天田同学对于在圣髑上涂鸦这件事有点不安，岳羽同学直率地安慰了他：“入乡随俗就好啦。你看，上面的涂鸦已经叠了很多层了，我们按照拉特兰人的方式来就好。”山岸同学在涂鸦的时候仔细观察了一会儿圣髑，下来之后小声地询问Dr.{@nickname}：“博士，这……确实是一台机器吧？”老师稍作思考，对她说：“现在已经不重要了。”
结城同学没有在圣髑上涂鸦许愿，他向Dr.{@nickname}微笑了一下，轻声说了什么。老师向他点了点头。
老师把喷漆罐递给了站在最后的埃癸斯同学，问：“你有想要许下的愿望吗，埃癸斯？”
埃癸斯同学接过了喷漆罐，但看起来有点儿犹豫。她望向圣髑，凝视它表面斑斓的色彩。从这里看过去，常人很难完全辨认上面的文字和图案，不过，也许埃癸斯同学是可以的。
她终于走上前去。她没有像拉特兰人那样留下醒目而鲜艳的涂鸦，似乎只是写下了一行小小的祈愿。
回到同伴们身边，她将喷漆罐还给了Dr.{@nickname}。虽然刚才询问过埃癸斯的愿望，老师此时却没有继续问下去。每个人都会有这种时候，有的心愿只想留给自己。
埃癸斯同学似乎还想询问什么，但终究还是没有开口。她又看向圣髑，阳光穿过穹顶落在她身上。也许她已经知晓，圣髑不会回答。

text.en:
There are far too many mysteries surrounding Aigis for me to know where to even begin... Let us start with her identity. Aigis and her companions made little effort to conceal it: Aigis is not an ordinary human. Or perhaps "not human" is more accurate, given that she refers to herself as an "Anti-Shadow Weapon." That being said, keeping her true nature under wraps has become my job... Ah, thank you for your understanding and assistance, my old friend. The decree from the Sixth Bureau helped a great deal.
As for the true nature of these so-called "Shadows" and S.E.E.S.'s operational plans against them, these youths have not shared much with me. I suspect, however, that this is simply because their own access to information is quite limited. The good news is that Aigis has confirmed the "monsters" appearing in Laterano are not Shadows. I have roughly narrowed down the potential nature of these creatures into five main hypotheses, which you will find in the attached file. After careful consideration, I believe the most likely outcome is that the "monsters" will cease all activity once they depart, or enter an entirely unobservable state.
Truth be told, I am far more concerned about the state of these children than I am about Shadows. They are all still very young, and should be enjoying a peaceful, tranquil life at school. Instead, they have already grown accustomed to facing danger and fighting Shadows, treating it as a duty they must shoulder. For Aigis, who calls herself an "Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapon," perhaps this is only natural. But in my eyes, she possesses a genuine, precious life just like any other child, and deserves the chance to experience its true value—whether here or after she returns home. I hope she finds the life that belongs to her, and that one day, no one will ever call her a "weapon" again.
text.zh:
埃癸斯身上的谜团实在太多，以至于我不知该从何说起……还是从她的身份开始吧。埃癸斯和同伴对此并没有多作隐瞒：埃癸斯不是普通的人类，或者，说“并非人类”也无妨，毕竟她自称为“反暗影兵器”。只是这样一来，隐瞒她的身份就成了我的工作……唉，谢谢老友你的谅解和协助，六厅的那道谕令帮了不少忙。
关于所谓“暗影”的本质和S.E.E.S.对暗影作战的计划，这些孩子并未向我透露太多，但我看得出来，这恐怕是因为他们自己掌握的信息也很有限。好消息是，埃癸斯确认了在拉特兰出现的“怪物”并非暗影，对于这些怪物本质的推测，我大约理出了五个方向，你记得查看附件。综合考量后我认为这件事概率比较高的走向是，“怪物”会在他们离开后停止活动，或者进入完全不可观测的状态。
比起暗影，我其实更担心这些孩子的状态。他们都还很年轻，本应在校园中享受安宁和平的生活，却已经习惯了冒着危险与暗影战斗，并把这当成了自己必须肩负的使命。对自称为“反暗影特殊压制兵装”的埃癸斯来说，这也许理所当然，但在我看来，她和其他的孩子一样，有着真切的、珍贵的生命，也应当有机会去体会生命真正的价值，无论是在这里，还是在归去之后。希望她会获得属于她的生活，有朝一日，无人再称她为“兵器”。
